entities.name: Francisco Javier Ramírez Acuña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Javier Ramírez Acuña is a Mexican politician who belongs to the National Action Party (PAN). He has been municipal president of Guadalajara, governor of Jalisco from 2001 to 2006 and, from 1 December 2006, to January 2008 he served as secretary of the interior in the cabinet of President Felipe Calderón. Since 2024 he sits in the Senate for the state of Jalisco.
